name: VinDr-CXR: Open Dataset of Chest X-rays with Radiologist Annotations
description: VinDr-CXR is a public medical imaging dataset comprising 18,000 chest X-ray scans collected from major hospital networks in Vietnam. Each radiograph was independently labeled by 17 experienced radiologists, providing bounding-box annotations for 22 critical local findings and classifications for 6 global thoracic diseases.
